mapper.select: select id, source_id, source_name, remind_time, remind_content, is_read, created_at, updated_at from reminder where id = #{id}
select id, source_id, source_name, remind_time, remind_content, is_read, created_at, updated_at from reminder order by remind_time desc
select id, source_id, source_name, remind_time, remind_content, is_read, created_at, updated_at from reminder where is_read = false order by remind_time desc
select id, source_id, source_name, remind_time, remind_content, is_read, created_at, updated_at from reminder where remind_time >= #{currentTime} and is_read = false order by remind_time asc
mapper.insert: insert into reminder (id, source_id, source_name, remind_time, remind_content, is_read, created_at, updated_at) values (#{reminder.id}, #{reminder.sourceId}, #{reminder.sourceName}, #{reminder.remindTime}, #{reminder.remindContent}, #{reminder.isRead}, #{reminder.createdAt}, #{reminder.updatedAt})
mapper.update: update reminder set source_id = #{reminder.sourceId}, source_name = #{reminder.sourceName}, remind_time = #{reminder.remindTime}, remind_content = #{reminder.remindContent}, is_read = #{reminder.isRead}, updated_at = #{reminder.updatedAt} where id = #{reminder.id}
update reminder set is_read = true, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
